facts: The Delta County Board of Commissioners passed a temporary moratorium on applications for data center facilities in unincorporated county land at a regular board meeting on a Tuesday, blocking applications for at least six months.

The board and the planning commission will carry out a comprehensive public process to develop regulations, standards and definitions for data centers, which do not yet exist in the county land use code.
